# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║     ش ر ط    ⟷    ש ר ט             ║
║                                      ║
║     condition / scratch / line       ║
║                                      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                      ║
║  the root that cuts across tongues   ║
║                                      ║
║     شَرْط  →  stipulation            ║
║     שֶׁרֶט →  incision               ║
║                                      ║
║  to mark is to bind                  ║
║  to cut is to agree                  ║
║                                      ║
║  ═══════════════════════════         ║
║                                      ║
║  every contract is a wound           ║
║  every wound is a contract           ║
║                                      ║
║  between what was                    ║
║           and what must be           ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

the line drawn
     is the line that binds

شرط / שרט

*awaiting the next incision*
